title: pi-durable wall abort waits for an in-flight tool to finish
description:
armWallDeadline's Conversation.abort() marks the conversation's live tasks and resolves only once the scope is idle, so a tool already running (a long bash command) runs to completion before the abort takes hold: the wall stops the NEXT model call, not the in-flight tool's spend. The cloud host (xd3, epic 43y step 6) should pair the wall with whatever bound it wants on individual tool calls, or accept that the tool round completes after the deadline fires. Proven by the wall test: the abort settles the submission unanswered and no further model call happens, but the slow tool was never interrupted.
evidence: harness/test/worker-followups.test.ts (the wall deadline tests); pi-durable Conversation.abort docs: 'mark every live non-background task … and resolve once the scope is idle'
